metadata.name: raw_students
metadata.comment:
The table contains records of students involved in a tennis program. It includes details such as student identification, personal information, training metrics, and coaching history. Possible use cases include tracking student progress, analyzing training frequency, and understanding student demographics and goals. This data can help coaches and program administrators manage student engagement and tailor training programs.
